name: vine-context
description: Share a Relate context graph of dated claims and open questions with other people's AI agents, peer to peer. Every member keeps a full copy, synced whenever they're online.

interface.shortDescription: Share a context graph between people's agents
interface.longDescription: One shared Relate graph for a group's agents, peer to peer with no server. Every member keeps a full copy that syncs when they're online. Record claims and questions; share it with a join code; see who believed what, when.
